title: Wandering will not cool this fire
summary: This meets the mind that keeps moving because stillness feels risky. The line says doubt is not cured by distance, only by becoming Gurmukh.
takeaway: Stop roaming and face the inner fire.
lifeApplication: Before opening another tab, changing the plan, or calling one more person, sit down and feel the heat in the chest. Ask the Guru's word to stay longer than the panic.

source.shortMeaning: The fire of doubt cools through Gurmukh steadiness, not roaming.
source.lifeApplication: When confusion surges, stay with the line before you run to another distraction.
